name: The Bedmate Game Sharehouse in Japan
original_name: しなければいけないシェアハウス in Japan
overview:
Juri joins the adults-only dating show "Must-Sleep-Together Sharehouse," where contestants must change bed partners daily and show physical affection every day. Inside, she reunites with her ex-boyfriend Yuta, the gentle Akihito, and the seductive Umi, while their ex-girlfriends move in as well. Romance or prize money? Juri wavers between instinct and reason.

Ayaka, Gennosuke, Yume Hayashi, Kano Takahashi, Daisuke Hayakawa, Ryudai Onikura
